contract: Resident supplied activation/weight/residual/gamma: 64x64 projection, residual add and row RMSNorm on 8x8 PEs. Ordinary typed matmul/add/rmsnorm graph, source forward two-hop DSR engine, joined resources, original CSL row collective and reusable local RMS library. Immutable inputs and last-use private buffer reuse; no intermediate host transfer. Eight SDK calls, exact output/inverse bits, fixed original-input native/device accuracy, mutation rejection and static ELF memory. Sampled mode additionally validates every projection prefix and normalization stages. Matched repaired-source comparison covers first three calls with observation/copy differences stated. No full Prefill or hardware performance claim.
